OPERATIVE SUMMARY
Procedure Date: 2026-01-20
Documented Status: completed
Preoperative Diagnosis: Documented right breast neoplasm.
Postoperative Diagnosis: Documented right breast neoplasm post-resection.
Procedure Performed: Right partial mastectomy with sentinel lymph node biopsy.
Anesthesia: General endotracheal anesthesia.
Estimated Blood Loss: Approximately 25 mL.
PREPARATION & SENTINEL NODE LOCALIZATION
The patient was identified, verified, and brought to the operating suite. Preoperative technetium-99m sulfur colloid radiotracer was
administered periareolarly. Gamma probe confirmed focal radioactive count in the right axilla prior to incision.

OPERATIVE NARRATIVE & TECHNIQUE
A curvilinear incision was made over the right breast upper-outer quadrant directly overlying the palpable lesion. Full-thickness excision of
the lesion was carried down to the pre-pectoral fascia. Specimen oriented with standard surgical sutures (superior, lateral, deep) and
submitted for surgical pathology.
A separate transverse incision in the lower right axilla was performed. Using the handheld gamma probe, two hot sentinel lymph nodes
were identified, dissected free, and sent for permanent histopathological evaluation.
Hemostasis achieved with electrocautery. Surgical counts verified correct. Wounds closed in anatomical layers using absorbable sutures.
Sterile dressings applied.
DOCUMENTED TEXT ANCHOR
